response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS b FROM station_avg) SELECT AVG(s.avg_bw) AS mean_of_above_baseline_station_avgs, AVG(s.avg_bw - baseline.b) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_avg s, baseline WHERE s.avg_bw > baseline.b;

assumptions.assumption: Stations whose telescopes all have NULL bandusagepct have no average and are excluded from the baseline calculation (each remaining station counts once).
Stations are grouped by telescopes.observstation, so only stations that have at least one telescope appear.
